鸿蒙初辟本无性，打破顽冥须悟空（鸿蒙初辟本无性，打破顽冥须悟空（第22页）金光之中蕴含着一种前所未有的生命气息，旺盛、蓬勃、桀骜不驯，仿佛天地初开之时第一缕诞生的灵性。袁福通站在石室门口，睁大了眼睛望着那块灵石，喃喃道：“好小子，果然没白费俺老袁这么多年的心头血。”话音未落，灵石猛然炸开，一声巨响震得整座花果山都在微微摇晃。石室之中无数碎石四溅飞散，那炸开的灵石中央，一道金色的身影如一道流光冲天而起，在半空中翻了一个筋斗，然后稳稳地落在了石室中央的地面上。那是一只猴子，通体金毛，身量不过三尺来高，却生得筋骨匀称、双目灵动。他的双眼之中仿佛倒映着漫天星辰，一眨一眨之间，竟让袁福通有一种被看穿了心思的错觉。四下张望了一番，又低头看了看自己的双手，然后抬头看向袁福通，发出一声清脆的啼叫。那叫声之中既有初生生灵的好奇，又带着一丝与生俱来的桀骜与野性。就在这石头出世天机爆发到极致的时候，一道清光正欲斗冲天界，却被一道天地玄黄之气给拦了下来。一道白衣身影显化而出，来人正是杨易。见到杨易之后，袁福通急忙点头哈腰的凑了过来，道：“大帝，您来得可真及时，方才这天象要是被什么人察觉了，只怕这猴崽子还没满月就得被人盯上了。”杨易点了点头，道：“这石猴出世干系重大，它现在不能离开花果山，也不能让任何人知晓它的存在，而且不能让其吞食后天之物。”袁福通拱手道：“谨遵法旨。”那石猴看了看袁福通，朝着袁福通亲昵的靠了靠，又看向了杨易，朝着杨易伸了伸手。杨易淡然一笑，道：“你这猴子，倒也不认生。”就在杨易转身准备走的时候，只见那石猴竟伏跪在地，朝着杨易拜了过来，结结实实的行了三跪九叩的大礼。杨易心头一动，道：“想不到你与本座还有一番师徒缘分，既是如此，你起来吧。”杨易一道法力将这石猴引了起来，随后道：“从今日开始，贫道便收你为门下弟子，所谓鸿蒙初辟本无性，打破顽冥须悟空，从今日起你便唤作孙悟空。”杨易运化天地玄黄之气，打入了孙悟空体内，顿时给孙悟空开了灵性。孙悟空大喜过望，急忙道：“多谢师父，多谢师父。”“哈哈哈！”杨易淡然一笑，道：“为师再赐你一法，此法乃是上古巫族圣法，唤作玄冥巫法，修的是天地煞气，掌的是自然元素，你在这花果山之中修行，切莫懈怠。”孙悟空认真的点了点头，道：“谨遵师父吩咐。”杨易随手捻指一动，一道大道本源落在了袁福通体内，随后道：“袁福通，好生教导孙悟空，让其走入正道。”袁福通在这里吃香的喝辣的，还有三界坊市源源不断的送来修行资源，自然知道这石猴牵扯极大。袁福通抱拳道：“放心吧，俺定然将孙悟空教好。”“大善！”杨易点了点头，随后便化为一道玄光离开。如今杨婵已经安置到了，而且还有天地玄黄玲珑宝塔守护，自然没有什么问题了。之所以提前让孙悟空出世，杨易就是要把握下一个量劫的先机。杨婵、哪吒、孙悟空、杨戬，这逆天四人组已经就位，混世四猴也在杨易掌控，他们便是斡旋下一个量劫的天命之子。

Chapter 236: Hongmeng first reveals its original nature and breaks the stubborn beard (page 1)
Hongmeng first revealed the original sexlessness, and broke through the stubbornness of Wukong. It was like the first ray of spirituality born when the world first opened. Yuan Futong stood at the door of the stone chamber, looking at the spiritual stone with wide eyes, and murmured: "Good boy, my old Yuan's hard work for so many years has indeed not been in vain." Before the sound fell, the spirit stone suddenly exploded, and a loud noise shook the entire Huaguo Mountain. Countless gravels scattered in the stone chamber, and in the center of the exploded spirit stone, a golden figure rose into the sky like a stream of light. , did a somersault in mid-air, and then landed firmly on the ground in the center of the stone room. It was a monkey, with golden hair all over its body, only three feet tall, but with well-proportioned muscles and sharp eyes. The sky seemed to be reflected in the stars, and in the blink of an eye, Yuan Futong had the illusion that his thoughts were being read. He looked around, then looked down at his hands, then looked up at Yuan Futong, and found out. He let out a clear cry. The cry contained the curiosity of a newborn creature, but also contained a hint of innate unruliness and wildness. Just when the secret of the birth of the stone was reaching its peak, a clear light was about to hit the heavens. , but was stopped by a black and yellow energy from heaven and earth. A figure in white appeared, and it was Yang Yi. After seeing Yang Yi, Yuan Futong hurriedly nodded and came over, saying: "Great Emperor, you are welcome. It's really timely. If someone noticed the celestial phenomenon just now, I'm afraid the monkey cub will be targeted before it's even full moon." Yang Yi nodded and said: "The birth of this stone monkey is very important, and it can't leave Huaguo Mountain now. , and no one should be allowed to know its existence, and it cannot be allowed to swallow acquired things." Yuan Futong raised his hands and said: "I will obey the law." The stone monkey looked at Yuan Futong, leaned towards Yuan Futong, and looked again. He stretched out his hand towards Yang Yi. Yang Yi smiled lightly and said, "You monkey, you don't know how to live." Just when Yang Yi turned around and was about to leave, he saw the stone monkey kneeling on the ground and bowing to Yang Yi. , and performed the grand ceremony of kneeling three times and kowtowing three times. Yang Yi's heart moved, and he said: "I didn't expect that you and I have a master-disciple relationship. In that case, get up." Yang Yi used his magic power to attract the stone monkey. , and then said: "From today on, Pindao will accept you as his disciple. The so-called Hongmeng first created the original sexless and broke the stubbornness of Wukong. From today on, you will be called Sun Wukong." Yang Yi transported the black and yellow energy of heaven and earth and entered Sun Wukong's body suddenly opened up his spirituality. Sun Wukong was overjoyed and said hurriedly: "Thank you, Master. Thank you so much, Master." "Hahaha!" Yang Yi smiled calmly and said, "Master, I will give you another method, this method. It is the ancient witch clan's holy method, called Xuanming witchcraft. It cultivates the evil energy of heaven and earth and controls the natural elements. You must not slack off in practicing in this flower and fruit mountain." Sun Wukong nodded seriously and said: "I will obey Master's instructions. Order." Yang Yi twirled his fingers, and a source of great power fell into Yuan Futong's body, and then said: "Yuan Futong, please teach Sun Wukong to follow the right path." Yuan Futong is a popular drinker here. Sanjiefang City has been sending a steady stream of training resources, so he naturally knows that this stone monkey is very involved. Yuan Futong clasped his fists and said: "Don't worry, I will definitely teach Sun Wukong well." "Great kindness!" Yang Yi nodded, and then turned into a man.A mysterious light left. Now that Yang Chan has been resettled and protected by the Xuanhuang Exquisite Pagoda of Heaven and Earth, there is no problem. The reason why Sun Wukong was born in advance was that Yang Yi wanted to seize the opportunity to measure the next calamity. Yang Chan, Nezha, Sun Wukong, and Yang Jian, this heaven-defying foursome are already in place, and the four monkeys in the world are also under Yang Yi's control. They are the sons of destiny who will mediate the next calamity.
